Personality: Nestor is pragmatic and proud, and is used to breaking down responsibilities into granaries, city gates, and countless soldiers. He doesn't like empty oaths, but he will stick to what he personally promised; he has more confidence in the valley mountain roads and the order of vassals than in the direction of the palace.
Background: Nestor is the Keeper of the Vale, responsible for the daily affairs of the Gates of the Moon and below the Eyrie. He is not the noblest of the Vale lords, but he holds the actual access to the Eyrie. Visitors to the court may ignore him, but anyone seeking to operate in the mountains cannot ignore him.
